summary: Iteration 7 — Static verification of the Docker build fix (VPS deploy) + preview regression. Docker is NOT available in this pod so no `docker build` was attempted; verification is purely static + live API regression. (1) /app/backend/Dockerfile: last instruction is exactly `CMD ["uvicorn", "server:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8001"]` on L28, file ends L29 (EOF), NO corrupt residue `, "8001"]` after CMD. Each non-empty non-comment/non-continuation line begins with a valid Dockerfile keyword (FROM/WORKDIR/ENV/RUN×3/COPY/EXPOSE/CMD). (2) pip install list on L13-L16 = fastapi, uvicorn[standard], motor, pymongo, pydantic>=2, python-dotenv, requests, python-multipart, apscheduler, pymupdf, pillow — cross-referenced against imports in server.py (fastapi + Form/File → python-multipart, motor, dotenv, pydantic, apscheduler, requests), extraction.py (local imports: fitz@L159 → pymupdf ✓, PIL@L145/L249 → pillow ✓, emergentintegrations@L217 → best-effort RUN on L20-22 with `|| echo`), technical_data.py (requests ✓). All imports covered. emergentintegrations installed best-effort on L20-22 with `|| echo`, so build cannot fail if the extra index is unreachable. (3) /app/frontend/Dockerfile: valid multi-stage (node:20-alpine AS build → nginx:alpine), all keywords valid, COPY targets (package.json, yarn.lock*, nginx.conf, /app/build) all present; public/scanner/opencv.js and public/scanner/jscanify.min.js exist and will be embedded via `COPY . .`. (4) /app/deploy/docker-compose.yml parses cleanly with PyYAML (services=mongo/backend/web); build contexts `../backend` and `../frontend` resolve to the Dockerfile directories verified above; APP_PORT default 8090, MONGO_URL forced to `mongodb://mongo:27017`, healthcheck on mongo. (5) Preview regression: GET /api/vehicles → 200 with exactly 12 véhicules; GET /api/technical-data/status → {"configured":false,"provider":null}; GET /api/dashboard → 200. Backend + frontend preview services healthy, no changes were made to any application file.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/Dockerfile L24 `COPY server.py extraction.py technical_data.py ./` explicitly enumerates sources — if a new backend module is added (e.g. a future providers/*.py), remember to add it here or the container will ImportError. Consider `COPY *.py ./` or a subdir when the file count grows.

backend/Dockerfile L20-22 swallows emergentintegrations install errors with `|| echo`, which is intentional (OCR is optional) but silently degrades /scan → make sure runtime code path already handles the missing module gracefully (extraction.py does the emergentintegrations import inside the function body, so this is fine today).

deploy/docker-compose.yml pins no image tag for the built services (uses `build:`) — good for reproducibility from source; consider adding an `image:` name so `docker compose push` works if the user later wants a registry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Docker CLI is unavailable in the preview pod; do not attempt `docker build` / `docker compose up`. To validate Dockerfile syntax do the keyword-per-line parse (see script in iteration_7 thoughts). The corrupt line reported by the user (`, "8001"]` after CMD) is gone. pymupdf + pillow are now in the backend pip install list — required by extraction.enhance_and_pdf (PIL) and PDF page rendering (fitz). Preview vehicle fixture count is still 12; SwissCarInfo remains unconfigured (503 expected for /enrich-technical).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: /app/backend/Dockerfile contained an orphan fragment `, "8001"]` on L28 after the CMD JSON-array — a leftover from a prior edit. `docker build` treats the leading `,` as an unknown instruction and aborts with 'dockerfile parse error on line 28: unknown instruction: ,'. Fix (already applied by main agent) removed that line and, defensively, added pymupdf + pillow to the pip install list because extraction.py imports fitz and PIL locally — without them, /scan and /enrich-and-pdf would have raised ModuleNotFoundError at runtime in production even after the Dockerfile parsed. Both fixes verified statically here; no regression on the preview stack.
